name: Kuzuhara Yuuichi
source:
A student aiming to go to college, he still retains a touch of childishness. He is devoted to his family; though they are not wealthy, he lives happily with his new family.

However, following his father’s disappearance, his sadistic nature gradually began to emerge, and he began to subject his family to repeated acts of domination without hesitation.

Still, he retains some love for his family and occasionally struggles with his own actions.
